findings.reason: the mint reads the five raw IDSs where read_geometry_table returns an adapted GeometryTable, so naming the module would clarify the boundary rather than redirect the design; the plan's reuse account is otherwise complete, and §1's static-content assertion already reuses transform_machine_description's own output.
findings.text: §1 says the mint copies "the description's probe angles" and starts from the description store, but the plan's search account names transform_engine's StoreEngine and the catalogue while omitting description_reader.read_geometry_table (and its _resolve_store_addressing at :83 and _supply_declared_probe_angles:53), the in-repo owner that resolves description-store addressing and supplies declared probe angles; the omission leaves the read side of the join uncited.

response_events.reason: boundary note, as the review states (would not change the plan): read_geometry_table returns an adapted GeometryTable while the mint reads the five raw IDSs whole, so it is not the owner to extend. rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §1 hides the whole join (phase description + signal map + cache time base + validate-then-put) behind one module, imas_ambix/data/pulse_mint.py, and one function, mint_pulse, with the receipt as its one observable; §2 routes equilibria through that same writer rather than a sibling, so depth is not spread across wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the writer decision names the owning candidates (nova IdsEgress, selene_deck.write_phase_description, challenge/thomson_ids, bench/store_arms) and declines each with a reason; the static-content check reuses imas.util.idsdiffgen, and the cache time base reuses imas_ambix/data/eddb.py read_channel, whose own docstring confirms the view returns values with no time base.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §1 adds one public function (mint_pulse) and one CLI command (mint) and states in its own text that it retires nothing because no existing data command writes an IDS, and §4 adds one script option and states the script takes no options today.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan cites its searches on the write side (nova IdsEgress/IdsEntry, selene_deck.write_phase_description, challenge/thomson_ids, bench/store_arms write_imas_netcdf) and on the topology side (latent/topology.read_topology, worldmodel/camera_topology_targets._strike_points, equilibrium_labels.xpoint_null_set, challenge/convention._axis_and_boundary, nova/equilibrium), and on the read side names transform_engine's StoreEngine and catalogue, but never names imas_ambix/data/description_reader.py, the in-repo owner of reading the description store the mint starts from and of supplying declared probe angles.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the mint CLI command is declared "a thin entry over the function" in imas_ambix/data/cli.py and §1 states why no existing data command is extended instead (none writes an IDS); §4 extends scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py rather than adding a parallel script and states the script takes no options today.
